def transform(grid):
    import copy
    out=copy.deepcopy(grid)
    one=[(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(grid) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v==1][0]
    two=[(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(grid) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v==2][0]
    r,c=one; tr,tc=two
    dr=1 if tr>r else -1 if tr<r else 0
    dc=1 if tc>c else -1 if tc<c else 0
    nr,nc=abs(tr-r),abs(tc-c)
    # diagonal portion first, then leftover axis portion
    for _ in range(min(nr,nc)):
        r+=dr;c+=dc
        if (r,c)!=(tr,tc): out[r][c]=3
    while r!=tr:
        r+=dr
        if (r,c)!=(tr,tc): out[r][c]=3
    while c!=tc:
        c+=dc
        if (r,c)!=(tr,tc): out[r][c]=3
    return out
